Name: BEHAVIOR_CHANGE_STATE_MATRIX_PARAM_ST
Description: Matrix of character states (grounded, dash, Quick Boost, death and others) used to change AI behaviour. Each row ticks the states it applies to and gives the AI action type and notification ID to switch to.

Fields.Name: State: Above Ground
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is on the ground.

Fields.Name: State: Dash
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is dashing.

Fields.Name: State: Crouch
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is crouching.

Fields.Name: State: Cover
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is in cover.

Fields.Name: State: Fall
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is falling.

Fields.Name: State: Aerial Dash
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is dashing in the air.

Fields.Name: State: Quick Boost
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is Quick Boosting.

Fields.Name: State: Slope Slip
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is sliding down a slope.

Fields.Name: State: While Riding
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is riding a vehicle.

Fields.Name: State: Floating
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is floating in the air.

Fields.Name: State: Leaning Out of Cover
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is leaning out of cover.

Fields.Name: State: Tank Grounded
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while a tank-type character is on the ground.

Fields.Name: State: Tank Fall
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while a tank-type character is falling.

Fields.Name: State: VOB
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies while the character is using VOB.

Fields.Name: State: Death whilst Grounded
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies when the character dies on the ground.

Fields.Name: State: Death whilst Aerial
Fields.Description: ON: the row applies when the character dies in the air.

Fields.Name: State: 16
Fields.Description: Unnamed state slot 16.

Fields.Name: State: 17
Fields.Description: Unnamed state slot 17.

Fields.Name: State: 18
Fields.Description: Unnamed state slot 18.

Fields.Name: State: 19
Fields.Description: Unnamed state slot 19.

Fields.Name: Transition AI Action Type
Fields.Description: AI action type to switch to when one of the ticked states applies.

Fields.Name: AI Notification Transition ID
Fields.Description: Transition ID sent to the AI as a notification when one of the ticked states applies.
